title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 94
description: Ten questions on Psalms 94: a cry to the judge of the earth against the proud, and trust in Yahweh as a high tower.

questions.text: In verse 1, Yahweh is called the God to whom what belongs?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 twice calls Yahweh the God to whom vengeance belongs.

questions.text: What is the judge of the earth asked to do in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve."

answers.text: Pay back the proud what they deserve
Forgive the proud all their sins
Rest from all his work on the earth
Build a new temple in the city

questions.text: According to verse 6, whom do the wicked kill?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says they kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

questions.text: What do the wicked say in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 quotes them: "Yah will not see, neither will Jacob's God consider."

questions.text: What does verse 9 ask about the one who formed the eye?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 asks: "He who formed the eye, won't he see?"

questions.text: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man. What does verse 11 say they are?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

questions.text: Who is called blessed in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says blessed is the man whom Yah disciplines and teaches out of his law.

answers.text: The man Yah disciplines and teaches
The man who is never corrected
The man who gathers great riches
The man who rules over the nations

questions.text: Unless Yahweh had been his help, where would the speaker's soul soon have lived?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says his soul would have soon lived in silence.

questions.text: When the speaker said "My foot is slipping!", what held him up?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says: "Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up."

questions.text: Complete verse 22: "Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my ..."
questions.explanation: Verse 22 calls Yahweh his high tower, his God, the rock of his refuge.
